definitions.explanation: The edible reproductive part of a plant.
The real content or substance of something (figurative).
The outcome or result of effort.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}が{実|み}を{結|むす}んだ。
{殻|から}を{割|わ}って{実|み}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Crack the shell and take out the nut inside.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{実|み}がなる (fruit grows, bears fruit)
・{実|み}を{結|むす}ぶ (to bear fruit, come to fruition)
・{実|み}を{付|つ}ける (to bear fruit)
・{実|み}のある{話|はなし} (substantive talk, meaningful discussion)
・{実|み}のない{話|はなし} (empty talk, meaningless discussion)

RELATED KANJI READINGS:
・{実|み} - fruit, content
・{実|じつ} - truth, reality (as in {実|じつ}は)
・{実|みの}る - to ripen, bear fruit (verb)

NOTE:
Distinguish from {身|み} (body) and {味|み} (taste) which share the same reading.
